comment: Source of truth for colour tokens. Everything under src/renderer/src/tokens
is GENERATED from this file by scripts/build-tokens.mjs — edit here, not there.
Each token carries `source` per mode:
figma       — read from the Figma variable, verified.
provisional — invented placeholder, NOT the real value. Replace.
new         — added in BU-4, needs mirroring back into Figma.
Exported from Figma 0GMEqKcFlQRBUgSpTpjAYN, frames Data Explorer – Prices
234:4402 (light) and 234:4541 (dark), cross-checked against Home 2:3 / 4:8
and the Status Pill set 68:351. All 24 Figma tokens agree across those.
BU-4's token list named 14. The real system has 24: it omitted chrome-text,
chrome-icon, info-*, and the four status-* pairs.
Four tokens are translucent (8-digit hex): surface, chrome-search-bg,
sidebar-active-bg and — in dark only — a different alpha on the last.

canvas.description: App background; also the zebra stripe inside surface cards.

surface.description: Card and pane fill. Translucent by design — a wash over canvas, not an opaque fill.

divider.description: Hairline rules inside a surface; table thead underline, dot separators.

text-secondary.description: Read-only field values, benchmark chart lines.

text-muted.description: Field labels, table headers, axes, footnotes.

accent.description: Primary chart series, affirmative button outlines, active states.

success.description: Positive signed numerics; right side of diverging bars.

danger.description: Negative signed numerics; left side of diverging bars.

chrome-border.description: Menu bar, sidebar and footer edges; chip strokes at 0.5px.

chrome-icon.description: Menu bar and sidebar glyph fill.

chrome-text.description: Menu bar label text. Same value as chrome-icon in both modes today, but kept separate because they are separate Figma variables and may diverge.

chrome-search-bg.description: Menu bar search field fill. Translucent by design.

info-text.description: Informational pill text. Tracks accent in both modes.

status-done-text.description: Completed job pill text (BU-21 job flow).

status-failed-text.description: Failed job pill text. Same value as danger in both modes today, but a separate variable.

sidebar-active-bg.description: Active sidebar page wash; also the full-row selection wash (taxonomy 5). Translucent, and the two modes use different alpha: light darkens canvas at 20%, dark lightens it at 15%.

series-2.description: NEW in BU-4. Second compare line. Previously borrowed success, which wrongly implied 'up'. Purple: distinct from accent blue, success green and danger red.

series-3.description: NEW in BU-4. Third compare line. Previously borrowed danger, which wrongly implied 'down'. Amber, tuned away from both status-running-* and raw.heatmap-mid so a chart line never reads as a running pill or a heatmap cell.

glass.description: Chrome popover fill — layout menu, data sources panel, search dropdown. Solved from the rendered frames (145:2 / 145:8), where the panel body over the canvas measures #f1e0cc light and #202020 dark: the glass DARKENS what is behind it. The color/glass variable alone (#ffedd8a6) does not reproduce that, so these are the values that match the mock.

comment: Mode-independent by design (taxonomy 9). Emitted as TS constants only —
deliberately NOT CSS variables, so they cannot be picked up by ordinary
themed components.
heatmap-*: the risk colormap is a measurement scale, not themed chrome,
so it must not flip between modes.
paper-*: everything inside a report page is raw ink. A factsheet is a
print artefact that happens to be shown on screen — it must look the
same in both themes, and identical to the PDF it will become.
